issue_request: FHIR-35963 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core vocabulary change request asking to replace the ambiguous note that there is no display defined for SNOMED CT expressions with text saying no display is provided in this example and linking to SNOMED International guidance.
initial_application: The issue was applied by f6696ef7b9b94b0060bcfcfb1ef98c29556105ec and merged by c35c47ba173a594144fc5fede3600ce5c682d708, changing source/terminologies.html to the approved wording. Current blame still attributes source/terminologies.html:199 to that implementation commit.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini maps resourceType pages to terminologies, confirming the checked source page is in the current build surface. The directly relevant Zulip thread shows the reporter raising the same ambiguity and Grahame Grieve clarifying that the base standard offers no guidance on how to use display for SNOMED CT expressions. Searches found no remaining current-source occurrence of the removed ambiguous sentence and no Confluence page directly referencing FHIR-35963.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current build-scope source already says no display is provided in the example and includes the requested SNOMED guidance link.
